core_rule: Redistribute validation responsibility without changing payout, paid, or verified accounting states.
routing_principles: Keep canonical control-plane validation separate from payout accounting.
Prefer west-side resilience for Oregon/Klamath proof routes while keeping cloud control stable.
Use edge devices as reroute-potential and heartbeat probes until telemetry proves higher roles.
Do not classify any projected validator revenue as verified or paid because of topology assignment.
All production failover remains operator-gated and advisory until health quorum and rollback proof exist.

tiers.name: canonical_control_plane
tiers.role: source of routing policy, manifest validation, public route checks, and deployment-state proof

tiers.name: west_resilience_anchor
tiers.role: regional validator anchor and west-side proof lane

tiers.name: oregon_edge_validation_ring
tiers.role: pilot heartbeat, packet checks, route score, and local reroute-potential evidence

tiers.name: northwest_observer_ring
tiers.role: observer/backup route scoring and regional comparison checks

current_assignments.notes: High-output validator-class record remains Needs Review. Use for west proof lane only after telemetry/source trace; do not treat reported output as verified revenue.
Use as pilot heartbeat and edge route check node. Keep micro-credit accounting separate from validation routing.
Use as secondary route-scoring and threshold-modeling node until more successful checks are collected.
Public route checker verifies route exposure. Domain aliasing remains separate from node payout logic.

minimum_pass_conditions: at least one oregon_edge_validation_ring node reports fresh heartbeat
fail_closed_on: public route 404 on required production alias
any attempt to mark projected payout as paid without payment evidence

accounting_guardrails.note: Topology redistribution is operational planning only. It does not verify revenue, bank settlement, or payout execution.
